authority: CEO R331 Gate 7 — evidence-bind all commercial numbers

classification_system.OBSERVED: Directly measured from real experiment or transaction
classification_system.SOURCE_DERIVED: Calculated from a cited published source (e.g., HCUP surgery cost data)
classification_system.MODELLED: Output of our computational model (e.g., 30% revision reduction)
classification_system.ESTIMATED: Rough calculation based on component costs, expert opinion, or analogy
